title: About
text: Loop is an SWE interview prep tool built around four screens: Today, Playground, Concepts, Review. No nav drawer, no menus — everything feeds the playground or learns from it.
— one AI-generated recommendation card based on your FSRS state.
— Monaco editor + Excalidraw diagrams + a Socratic AI companion + the Feynman Gate (explain it back, get graded 0–100).
— FSRS mastery heatmap across a 60-concept taxonomy (DSA / LLD / HLD / Behavioral).
— weekly AI report summarizing what you actually learned vs. what you ground.
Confidence isn't binary. Loop uses FSRS spaced repetition with a decay curve
so you can see mastery slip over time on the heatmap and Today surfaces what's actually fading.
+ key + model in settings. The Socratic companion, auto-tagger, and Feynman grader all use the same adapter. Local dev can use the bundled Express bridge that proxies
cognitive fitness through hard novel problems at the edge of skill in your chosen domain
— compounding crystallized intelligence in a complex domain to resist later decline — not raising fluid intelligence (mostly fixed after ~25). Below are the load-bearing sources behind the design.
2012. Education, occupational complexity, and lifelong cognitive engagement attenuate the clinical impact of equivalent neuropathology.
2011. 12 mo moderate aerobic training reversed ~1-2 years of age-related hippocampal atrophy; gains correlated with BDNF.
— Chase & Simon 1973. Chess masters recall real positions far better than novices but match them on random positions. Same 4 working-memory slots, bigger units.
— Roediger & Karpicke 2006. Free recall produces ~50% better long-term retention than re-reading. Meta-analytic effect size g ≈ 0.5-0.7. Powers FSRS + the Feynman Gate.
— Bjork. Spacing, interleaving, and retrieval feel worse in the moment and produce durably better learning. Drives the cross-track interleaving and Recommended row in Practice.

— Salthouse. Speed-of-processing decline accounts for 70-90% of age-related variance in reasoning tasks. Why post-25 strategy is compounding domain knowledge (Gc), not chasing fluid intelligence (Gf).
2013. Interstitial waste clearance is ~2x faster during sleep. Why sleep is treated as upstream of any cognitive work.
What doesn't (and why this isn't a brain-training app)
Psychological Science in the Public Interest
: robust near transfer, no compelling far transfer, no real-world cognitive benefits.
— FTC fined $2M in 2016 for unsupported claims of school / work / age-related benefits.
— Jaeggi 2008 dual N-back result has largely failed to replicate (Redick 2013; Melby-Lervåg meta-analyses). WM slot count is fixed; effective capacity scales via chunking in LTM.
— Macnamara, Hambrick & Oswald 2014: ~4% variance in education, <1% in professions. Practice matters, but the strong "10,000 hours" claim is empirically wrong.

Tools that perform generation for you can atrophy what they replace. Focus mode is the audit affordance — a deliberate "no AI assist" mode you can flip on, tracking how often you train without scaffolding.
— Dahmani & Bohbot 2020. Heavy lifetime GPS use linked to worse spatial memory; longitudinal subsample showed steeper hippocampal-dependent decline in heavy users.
— Maguire et al. 2006. Years of "Knowledge" training correlated with posterior-hippocampal gray-matter enlargement. Experience-dependent plasticity, both directions.
— Henkel 2014. Photographing museum objects produced worse recognition and detail memory than just observing them.
— Lee et al. (Microsoft / CMU) CHI 2025. Higher confidence in AI correlated with reduced critical-thinking engagement; work shifts from generation to verification.
— Kosmyna et al. MIT Media Lab 2025. LLM-assisted writing showed weakest neural connectivity (alpha / theta bands) and worst recall of own writing. Preprint, n=54.
— Feynman Gate forces you to commit before any AI feedback (generation effect).
— Reviews ask free-recall, not multiple-choice (testing effect, g ≈ 0.5-0.7).
— Spacing (FSRS), interleaving, retrieval over re-reading. Feels worse, works better.
— The Companion probes; it doesn't give solutions when learning is the goal.
— Per-track ELO picks drills near your current level. No leaderboard; the number is diagnostic, not the goal.
— Feynman Gate grades 0-100 with surfaced gaps. The deep-processing step LLM-assist tends to skip.
— Focus mode tracks no-tools sessions per week. If you can't do it without the tool, you've offloaded the capacity, not augmented it.
